evidence.citation: “Re-evaluate all cases—A, B, and C—not just B—to detect regressions” and “The live checkout is clean after every run.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The requested reruns validate that B’s fix is repeatable and that A/C did not regress. Fresh blind runners, independent judging, and checkout-cleanliness checks protect validity, isolation, and integrity; the additional A/C reruns are conditional rather than mandatory.
